row.applicability_boundary_en: The reported example does not meet the below-1% loss target. No Qwen3.8-27B, domain-model or Ascend result is established.
row.applicability_boundary_zh: 论文案例未达到本业务小于1%损失目标；未在Qwen3.8-27B、领域降噪/翻译模型或昇腾验证。
row.direction_zh: 权重 × 量化 · 校准损失
row.next_step_en: Compare MSE with MSE+SW at fixed model, bits, grouping and calibration data. Record calibration time and task quality. Test supported 310P/910B execution formats only after quality passes; confirm the 950 SKU first.
row.next_step_zh: 在同一模型、相同位宽/分组与校准集下比较MSE和MSE+SW，记录校准时间、领域任务质量及导出格式；只有质量接近目标且不改变执行格式，才进入310P/910B对应运行栈的性能验证。950需确认型号和软件支持。
row.selection_reason_en: Compare distribution alignment when low-bit quality, rather than kernel availability, is the bottleneck. Activation-aware calibration does not imply activation quantization.
row.selection_reason_zh: 若当前低比特方案主要卡在质量而非算子支持，可把SW损失作为现有校准流程的对照变量；不将激活校准解释为激活已量化。

row.applicability_boundary_en: Optimal reconstruction is not equivalent to optimal task quality. Ascend speedup requires measurement; the 950 SKU is unknown.
row.applicability_boundary_zh: 不把理论重建最优当作任务质量最优；两段GEMM在昇腾是否更快要实测。950型号未知，不假定算子支持。
row.next_step_en: Start with modest rank reduction in major linear layers. Compare the original GEMM with two factorized GEMMs, including launch cost and end-to-end throughput. Expand only after task quality passes the agreed below-1% gate.
row.next_step_zh: 选当前服务中占权重主要开销的线性层，先以较轻的秩缩减做层级质量消融；对照未分解层与两段矩阵乘，记录实际格式、额外launch和端到端吞吐。质量先过小于1%门槛再扩大层范围。
row.selection_reason_en: Use the method to screen sensitive layers efficiently. Task-quality loss remains a stricter limit than compression preparation speed.
row.selection_reason_zh: 可用于快速筛出低秩压缩敏感层，尤其领域模型可小范围试验；现有结果提示质量门槛比压缩计算速度更先决定可用性。

row.applicability_boundary_en: A trained mapper and same-family model pair are required. GPU results do not establish async gains on 310P/910B/950; Qwen3.8-27B was not evaluated.
row.applicability_boundary_zh: 需要训练mapper和同家族模型对；作者GPU结果不证明310P/910B/950有同样异步收益，Qwen3.8-27B也未在论文中验证。
row.direction_zh: KV Cache · 缓存淘汰与代理评分
row.next_step_en: At fixed context length and KV retention, compare full KV, a lightweight eviction baseline and proxy scoring. Include proxy-model weights and peak activations; measure TTFT, TPOT, concurrency and quality. Stop if resource contention cancels gains.
row.next_step_zh: 先用现有模型与同家族小模型，固定上下文长度和KV保留比例，对比完整KV、现有轻量淘汰与代理评分。计入小模型权重/峰值激活，量TTFT、TPOT、并发上限和任务质量；若单设备资源争用抵消收益则不推广。
row.selection_reason_en: Consider it when long-context KV capacity and importance-scoring time are material bottlenecks. It selects tokens, not feature channels.
row.selection_reason_zh: 适用于已有长上下文KV容量压力且评分耗时明显的服务；价值在缩短评分路径，不应仅看保留比例或把它归入KV特征通道剪枝。

row.applicability_boundary_en: Preprint v1 published on 2026-08-16 and reviewed here on 2026-10-16. Results are author-reported, not locally reproduced; no Qwen3.8-27B or Ascend 310P/910B/950 measurements are reported. Numerical error over 128-token kernel rollouts does not establish task-quality loss below 1%. The 7.83× result concerns state-write traffic in one configuration, while auxiliary logs still require storage.
row.applicability_boundary_zh: 论文为 2026-08-16 的预印本 v1，本次于 2026-10-16 补充审阅。性能为作者报告，尚未本地复现；没有 Qwen3.8-27B、310P、910B 或 950 实测。128-token 算子数值误差不能证明业务精度损失小于 1%；7.83 倍是特定配置的状态写流量降低，额外日志仍占空间。
row.next_step_en: Prototype the GDN append–merge path. Confirm recurrent layers in the actual model configuration and execution graph, then use an existing 910B environment where the model already runs. Compare eager dense write-back with M=2/4/8/16 at identical inputs/state precision and representative batches. Measure full-cycle amortized latency, merge spikes, HBM bytes and extra log storage; then assess model TPOT, throughput and task quality. Expand only if the agreed quality loss stays below 1%, model-level gains are stable and latency requirements hold. Stop if kernel gains disappear at model level or log overhead cancels them. Revisit 950 after identifying the SKU/runtime; include 310P only if its operator/precision path is executable.
row.next_step_zh: 具体穿刺 GDN 的“追加—合并”执行方式。先从实际模型配置和执行图确认递归层，在已有可运行模型的 910B 环境，对照逐步稠密写回与 M=2/4/8/16；固定输入与状态精度，覆盖实际 batch 分布。测整周期摊销耗时、merge 单步尖峰、HBM 读写字节和日志额外占用，再接入模型比较 TPOT、吞吐与业务质量。只有约定质量指标损失小于 1%、模型级收益稳定且时延门槛不被破坏才扩大改造；仅算子提速或日志开销抵消收益时停止。950 待型号和运行栈确认后复测，310P 按算子与精度支持决定是否纳入。
row.selection_reason_en: A conditional kernel experiment is worthwhile: the method targets state-write bandwidth during high-concurrency decoding and improved TPOT without changing weights in the authors' prototype. The target model must have relevant recurrent layers such as GDN/KDA with a material state-write-back cost. This is adjacent research, not direct evidence for weight quantization, conventional KV compression or approximate low-rank factorization.
row.selection_reason_zh: 值得优先做有条件的算子穿刺：它针对高并发解码中的状态写带宽，能够在不改模型权重的情况下改善 TPOT。适用前提是实际模型有 GDN/KDA 等递归层，且这些层的状态写回确实占用较多时延；不作为现有权重量化、KV 压缩或近似低秩分解专题的直接成果。
